verification: Executed original base functions extracted with git show and current source functions through Node. For routing findings, also checked the actual memoryEligibleForView eligibility predicate. No provider calls or repository changes.

findings.title: Keep list-contained headings from closing document scope
findings.reason: The newly accepted indented heading is inside the list item, but the global stack pops the outer same-depth hypothesis. This silently removes the governing qualification and admits the content as factual. The reverse shape also leaks a list-local hypothesis into a later top-level factual paragraph.
findings.suggestedBoundary: Track Markdown container ownership when opening/closing headings, or conservatively preserve enclosing scope for headings inside lists. Add both qualifier-removal and outward-leak cases.

findings.title: Do not treat emitted device errors as attributed reports
findings.query: Какое сообщение об ошибке передаёт дисплей Zephyr QX-100?
findings.reason: A display transmitting its error message is observable device data. The new generic сообщение + передаёт matcher treats it as a relayed attributed claim, so ordinary factual memory recording the displayed error is excluded. Existing negative tests cover показал but not the newly matched передаёт.
findings.suggestedBoundary: Distinguish mechanical message output from an explicit attributed/relayed content request; retain the factual route for this shape.

findings.title: Bind assistant speculation to the requested clause
findings.query: What color is Zephyr QX-100? The assistant speculated about its warranty.
findings.reason: The new unanchored assistant-speculation cue has unconditional top precedence even in a separate sentence about a different attribute. The requested color fact becomes ineligible solely because unrelated context mentions speculation.
findings.suggestedBoundary: Require the speculation cue to express the requested material, respecting independent question/clause boundaries.

findings.title: Do not route a requested plan by rejection inside an if-clause
findings.query: Какой план Ada Marlow выберет, если Bo Winters отверг предложение об осмотре?
findings.reason: The new rejection pattern matches отверг предложение entirely inside the conditional clause. Excluding если from the connecting gap does not guard a conditional introducer before the matched pair. The question requests a plan contingent on rejection, not an actual rejected historical item.
findings.suggestedBoundary: Account for the clause governing the matched rejection, including preceding если without бы, and avoid letting subordinate conditions override the requested plan.

findings.title: Do not let an English title token override an explicit Russian question request
findings.query: Какой открытый вопрос остаётся по документу Report 1111?
findings.reason: Global cross-language precedence now tests the bare English report token before the already recognized Russian open-question request. Here Report 1111 is the document title, so report is the topic rather than the requested view. Existing question memory is hidden by the new precedence.
findings.suggestedBoundary: Prioritize explicit requested discourse over incidental topic/title vocabulary while retaining mixed-language report-about-plan behavior.

otherObservations: Additional broad fictional-object and competing-software-version examples show heuristic ambiguity, but are not included as separate required findings. The five listed cases have direct base/head behavior and evidence-eligibility reproductions.
